observed_failure: MPI_Allgather reports MPI_ERR_TRUNCATE, including on rank7, and exits15 before result output.
finding: The program partitions 1031 bodies unevenly over 128 ranks (nine bodies on ranks0-6, eight on ranks7-127), but uses fixed-count MPI_Allgather with each caller's own local count as recvcount. These incompatible counts cause truncation on eight-body receivers; nine-body receivers also describe 1152 bodies in a 1031-body buffer.
interpretation: Pre-existing uneven-partition collective-count defect independent of concurrent scheduling. Retain failed external validation without retry.
investigation: Static source/count inspection and retained MPI diagnostic; no new program execution.
